E0971

A module discovered by `find(…)` has its own `imports:`.

What

A module discovered by `find(…)` has its own `imports:`.

Why

The liftability law (U4): modules contribute to the merged whole, they never import each other — nesting `find` would make composition explode and break "drop a file in."

Fix

remove the `imports:` from the discovered module; declare all `find(…)` directives in the top-level env.jet.
